summary: Layer 1B expands the US-tradable universe around the advanced glass / T-glass substrate bottleneck. The reference anchor is Nitto Boseki, where evidence supports direct exposure to T-glass, NE/NER/NEZ glass, AI servers, semiconductor package substrates, switches, routers, and NICs. The underfollowed lane adds adjacent substrate and high-speed laminate suppliers whose exposure is plausible but needs verification through customer wins, capacity disclosures, and AI-server-qualified material revenue.
